description: Two Low findings deferred on #2769, plus one gap left open by the replacement plan. (1) The Claude auth pattern (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/absence.py:28) captures the rest of the error line into Absence.detail. That text is published in the report without the credential and long-token redaction that excerpt() applies. The report is posted as a PR review, where Actions secret masking does not apply, so a secret in that line would be published unredacted. (2) parse_reset understands only "Resets in <duration>". Claude's "resets 7:50pm (America/New_York)" and Codex's "try again at Oct 9th, 2026 6:08 PM" leave reset_at empty, so pool blocks are not kept between runs. (3) In absence.py, CALIBRATED_QUOTA_PATTERNS["muse"] is empty, so a muse quota error is recorded as a plain error: the chain falls through, but the pool is not blocked until reset and the report does not name the cause. The agy auth entry (CALIBRATED_AUTH_PATTERNS["agy"]) is owned by oracle-agy-reviewer-calibration-20261008.
